# Test fixtures

- `muybridge-161-*.jpg`: four frames of *Animal Locomotion*, plate 161 ("Man in pelvis cloth standing and jumping"),
  Eadweard Muybridge, 1887. Public domain. Source: [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Man_in_pelvis_cloth_standing_and_jumping_(rbm-QP301M8-1887-161).jpg).
  Used by the `board` suite (several photos to an animation).
- `muybridge-161.gif`: the same four frames as an animated GIF (200×400, 32 colours). Used by the `refs` suite (a GIF to an animation).
- `pano-sun.jpg`: a made-up 2:1 panorama, sky to ground, with a bright sun at u = .25, v = .3. Used by the `refs` suite (the light from a panorama).
